subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel & multi-PO template questions
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@greenbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts.payable@greenbridge.com
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding questions — invoice submission (portal vs email)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. A couple of quick questions from our AP team as we prepare to start sending invoices to Redwood:

1) Do you require us to use the Redwood Vendor Portal, or is emailing invoices to invoices@redwood.com an acceptable long-term option?
2) If portal is preferred, is there any mandatory field mapping we should populate (PO number placement, line-item SKU, tax/VAT fields)?
3) We frequently issue multi-PO invoices where a single invoice covers 2–3 Redwood POs — do you prefer separate invoices per PO or one invoice with PO lines listed?

I've attached our standard W-9 and a sample invoice for reference.

Attachments: greenbridge_w9.pdf (application/pdf), greenbridge_sample_invoice.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks,
Claire Hughes
Vendor Ops / Greenbridge Inc.
claire.hughes@greenbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — invoice submission (portal vs email)

Hi Claire — great to meet you earlier. Short answers up front and details below.

- Preferred path: Vendor Portal (link below) — provides faster ACKs, automatic PO matching, and reduces manual processing.
- Email fallback: invoices@redwood.com is supported as a backstop during migration. Please use subject token: "GBR-PO:{PO_NUMBER}" so our parser can associate.
- Multi-PO handling: Portal -> you can attach multiple PO numbers on a single invoice record (we prefer line-level PO tags). Email -> if a single PDF covers multiple POs, include a separate invoice line for each PO and list PO numbers in the subject (e.g., "GBR-PO:12345,67890").

Required minimal fields (portal or email):
- Redwood PO number (mandatory)
- Invoice date
- Invoice number (unique)
- Line-level description and net amount
- Tax/VAT amount and currency

I'll loop in Jordan (AP operations) and Vanessa (vendor onboarding) for any edge cases. In the meantime, here are the links: vendor portal signup: https://console.redwood.ai/vendor-portal/signup?invite=greenbridge-2028 and our sample templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-vendor-templates

If you want, we can schedule a short API/portal walkthrough for your AP team next week.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — that's helpful. A couple of follow-ups from AP:

- VAT: we need to submit VAT breakdowns on line level; will the portal accept separate VAT columns?
- Credit notes / adjustments: what subject token should we use for credit memos so they don't get treated as invoices?
- Timing: if we migrate to the portal, how long before it's live for Greenbridge? We need a 2-week runway to align internal systems.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood requires PO stamping on the invoice PDF itself, or is placing the PO number in the subject/metadata sufficient?

Claire

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenbridge — confirm portal behavior & email parser rules

Team — quick decision items for onboarding Greenbridge (they attached W-9 and sample invoice):

1) VAT handling: Portal accepts line-level VAT fields. For email fallback, AP parser will map a column named "VAT" or "Tax" and drop into tax_amount. If neither present, we flag for manual review.
2) Credit memos: Use subject token "GBR-CREDIT:{ORIGINAL_INVOICE}" so parser routes to adjustments queue rather than invoice ingestion.
3) PO stamping: We do NOT require visible PO stamp within the PDF as long as the PO number is present in the subject or the first page top-right. If the parser cannot find it, we'll route to manual matching with a 72-hour SLA for review.
4) Multi-PO PDFs: Acceptable if each PO is listed on a separate invoice line AND PO numbers are included in the subject (comma-separated). We'll record multiple PO links in the ledger. Please update the portal onboarding guide to call this out.

Attachments: multi_po_mapping_notes.csv (internal mapping examples) — I've attached sample regex rules for the parser.

Jordan/Vanessa — please confirm and I'll send a consolidated reply to Claire with the timeline. They requested a 2-week runway; can we provision portal access and an onboarding walkthrough for 2028-08-09?

Thanks,
Hannah
